product_metadata.title: Clara Clark 1800 Premier Series 4pc Bed Sheet Set - King, Purple Eggplant
features: LUXURY 4 PIECE BED SHEETS KING SIZE, - Set Includes; 1 flat sheet 102" x 105", 1 fitted sheet 78" x 80", 2 pillowcases 20" x 40". Deep pocket fitted sheet for deep mattress of 14" to 18" inches, with an elastic all around the sheet.

ULTRA SOFT QUALITY: Made of pure 100% Microfiber fabric, Clara Clark Microfiber is carefully double brushed on both sides to increase ultimate luxury, softness, cool and breathable, specially crafted for your highest level of comfort. Designed in a special way to hold super strong for many years to come.

DEEP POCKET FITTED SHEETS: Deep pocket sheets fits up to 16 inch mattresses. These are great for extra deep mattresses and fits well mattresses with memory foam mattress toppers or big mattress pads! A stretchable elastic all around the entire sheet ensures a tight, secure fit that won’t ride up or move around in middle of the night.

ELEGANT AND VIBRANT: Fabulous selection of vibrant colors, specially dyed that the color should not fade and always stay beautiful and colorful, the classic stripe detail is a beautiful, elegant way to update your bedroom.

SPECIAL EASY CARE: Fade, stain, shrink and wrinkle resistant. Machine washable in cold, dries quickly on tumble dry low temperature. Tip: Remove promptly from dryer, place right away on bed, it will look beautiful and neat, like ironed sheets.
description: Clara Clark's Premier 1800 Collection deluxe microfiber sheets are made of luxuriously silky brushed microfiber fabric. Soft and breathable, they wick perspiration away to let you sleep in comfort. And for a touch of elegance, the pillowcases are detailed with classic three-line embroidery. Available in a wide range of tasteful, fade-resistant colors, the sheet sets include a fully elasticized fitted sheet that accommodates extra-thick mattresses.
